title: Keto Eastern Lamb Kibbeh
description: A keto twist on the traditional Middle Eastern dish, featuring lamb and kibbeh in a flavorful and savory recipe.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground lamb, kibbeh, olive oil, middle eastern spices, and eggs. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and shape into a flat layer.
Sprinkle almond flour and feta cheese on top of the lamb mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
